g.text: openmeet-platform: audio capture (cpal on a dedicated thread, 16 kHz mono frames)
Drop: sends Msg::Stop, joins the thread
«cfg(windows)» "WASAPI loopback": input stream on the output device
otherwise unsupported ("Virtual audio device", e.g. BlackHole selectable)
host is PulseAudio (incl. pipewire-pulse); unsupported on plain ALSA
